title: Starter App Visuals and README Diagrams for Template Apps
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Design and deliver a complete visual kit and README diagrams for the Template Apps quickstart. Deliverables include responsive reference app screenshots (desktop/tablet/phone), annotated flows for README (architecture + data flow + auth callouts), exported assets (SVG/PNG/GIF for animated walkthroughs), and a Figma file with clear export naming and usage notes for engineering and docs. Goals: reduce new user time-to-first-success, provide consistent imagery across marketing/docs/repo, and make onboarding reproducible for Dedicated/Private customers.
acceptance_criteria: Desktop/tablet/mobile screenshots exported at required resolutions (3x where appropriate) and named per export spec
README flow diagram in SVG + simplified PNG fallback included in repo with alt text and short caption
Annotated screenshot set with callouts for key UI elements (API key, model selector, run button, logs) available as separate layer exports in Figma
Animated GIF or MP4 10s onboarding loop for hero section in docs (<= 2MB when compressed)
Figma file shared with engineering/docs with access + a single page 'Export instructions' explaining naming conventions and responsive breakpoints
tasks: Audit existing reference app screenshots in docs repo and note missing variants
Create new low-fidelity flow sketches for README (auth, request lifecycle, model routing, fallback) and review with PM/Eng
Design high-fidelity screenshot templates and reusable callout components (accessible color variants)
Export assets at required densities and upload to docs repo and CDN staging folder
Write README captions and alt text snippets and add to docs PR
Run a quick accessibility color check and provide 2 alternate color palettes for dark/light docs themes

notes_for_engineering_and_docs: Place assets in /assets/template-apps/<version>/ and reference stable filenames (do not include timestamp in production filenames)
Use SVG for flow diagrams where possible; include small PNG fallback for legacy browsers
In README, use the provided 3-step caption below each screenshot: 1) What the user sees, 2) Why it matters, 3) Next step
For Private/Dedicated screenshots, blur tenant-identifying info and annotate with 'Demo data' label
If runtime UI diverges between Hosted and Dedicated, we provide an extra 'Dedicated' screenshot set and call it out in README
